name: Kankin Ryoujoku Choukyou Hazuki & Mio
original_name: 監禁陵辱調教 葉月＆美緒
source:
My name is Keisuke, secretly called K. I'm quite famous among underground sex slave breeders. I've bred a lot of sex slaves as my clients wish. One day, I receive an offer from the boss of a certain company. Of course, it's to breed a sex slave. But, the girl is the boss's wife....

[From ErogeShop]
